en: The Sūtra on the Buddha’s Teaching of the Mantra for Children:

Homage to the Bhikṣu-saṃgha of the South; homage to the Seven Buddhas of the Past; homage to all Buddhas; homage to the disciples of all Buddhas. May my incantation be fulfilled according to my wishes.
If a child suffers from headaches or abdominal pain,
reciting this seven times shall bring immediate recovery.
This is the *Buddha-spoken Sūtra on the Incantation for Children*.
